name: Otto
about: One of the 3D Cartoon office cast: a lavender top and a green beanie.
heightNote: the source skill gives no height: an everyday adult's

can.views: any angle (a 3D rig): front, three-quarter, profile, back and between
can.faceNotes: happy = the source skill's smile, surprised = alarmed, worried = wince; laugh and angry are the app's (mw:c3d-cast setFace)
can.poseNotes: setPose with the source skill's STAND, SIT, walkPose, mixPose; poseReach and legIK (two-bone IK); POINT and WAVE from mw:c3d-cast
can.hands: n/a: hand spheres, gripping a prop at its userData.grip
can.walk: walkPose(phase) with legIK for planted feet
can.talk: one open mouth (talk), flapped by talkFace(t); no lip sync
